snapshot.scope: Independent Product Planning review of the first B6.13/E6.08 note-only Markdown editor: the current Reader render opens one exact bounded portable draft; save is revision/CAS fenced, returns the canonical safe render, records a reversible update_page Operation, and preserves the draft and live file on stale; statuses remain unchanged.

reviewers.independence: Product Planning reviewed Markdown, API, UI, sync, recovery, Decision and trace owners against the combined service/registrar/Reader implementation; Development and UI own those product and focused-test bytes.

dimensions.summary: The same stable note page moves from Reader render to exact draft and back to a refreshed canonical render; source pages remain read-only.
Markdown, API, sync, recovery and Decision owners agree on render/revision identity, exact draft CAS, atomic replace, reversible update_page and stale behavior.
PIGE-UI-001 and E6.05 remain partial and E6.08 remains planned while the first note-only editor evidence is bound without status promotion.
Canonical schemas, exact Reader registrar channels and closed save outcomes give Development and UI one bounded note-editing surface.
Existing Markdown, API, UI, sync, recovery, Decision and trace owners bind the slice without a new document or merge framework.

verification.evidence: Editor schemas and exact Reader registrar channels remain canonical and body/path-free.

verification.command: npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:decisions
verification.evidence: Markdown, API, UI, sync, recovery and accepted-decision owners pass without a new document.

verification.command: npm run verify:traceability && npm run verify:boundaries
verification.evidence: Unchanged-status note-editing acceptance stays synchronized and the protected registrar/service inventory covers the final combined source.

coordination.compatibility: Existing notes, Reader rendering and Activity history remain readable; new saves add opaque revision fencing and a reversible update_page Operation without migrating prior pages.
coordination.acknowledgement: Planning binds the first note-only Markdown editor; source-page editing, create/rename/delete, rich text, automatic merge and broader platform acceptance stay open.

nonBlockingRisks: Real Electron IME, long-page and platform behavior remain acceptance work.
